list.name: bot_filter
list.label: Account Filter
list.query: All Accounts : 1 = 1, Exclude High-Freq Bots (<= 15 posts/hr) : post_count <= 15, Exclude Bots (<= 5 posts/hr) : post_count <= 5, Bots Only (> 15 posts/hr) : post_count > 15

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(passed_sieve) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1) FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT round(100.0 * sum(dropped_replies) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1) FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT round(100.0 * sum(dropped_non_en) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1) FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: Live Ingestion Rate: Raw Firehose vs Passed Sieve (Events/sec)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 10 SECOND) AS time, round(avg(raw_rate), 1) AS "Raw Firehose (Total msgs/s)", round(avg(passed_rate), 1) AS "Passed Sieve (Forwarded msgs/s)" FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sieve Funnel Distribution: Pass vs Filtered Slices

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'Passed Sieve (Forwarded to AI)' AS outcome, sum(passed_sieve) AS count FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Filtered: Replies & Threads' AS outcome, sum(dropped_replies) AS count FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Filtered: Non-English' AS outcome, sum(dropped_non_en) AS count FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT arrayJoin(hashtags) AS hashtag, count(*) AS "Post Count" FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND hashtag != '' GROUP BY hashtag ORDER BY "Post Count" DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Sentiment Breakdown per Top Hashtags (100% Stacked)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  arrayJoin(hashtags) AS hashtag,
  countIf(sentiment = 'positive') AS Positive,
  countIf(sentiment = 'neutral') AS Neutral,
  countIf(sentiment = 'negative') AS Negative
FROM bluesky.enriched_posts
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
  AND hashtag != ''
GROUP BY hashtag
HAVING Positive + Neutral + Negative >= 2
ORDER BY (Positive + Neutral + Negative) DESC
LIMIT 12

SELECT arrayJoin(hashtags) AS hashtag, round(avg(virality), 2) AS avg_virality, count(*) AS sample_posts FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND hashtag != '' GROUP BY hashtag HAVING sample_posts >= 2 ORDER BY avg_virality DESC, sample_posts DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Most Active Posters (Controlled by Account Filter Toggle)

targets.rawSql: SELECT author_did, count(*) AS post_count, round(avg(virality), 2) AS avg_virality, topK(1)(category)[1] AS dominant_category FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY author_did HAVING ${bot_filter} ORDER BY post_count DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT geo_region AS region, count(*) AS "Mention Count" FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND geo_region != 'global_none' GROUP BY region ORDER BY "Mention Count" DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT '1. Raw Firehose Ingested' AS stage, sum(raw_received) AS post_count, '100.0%' AS retention_share FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT '2. Dropped: Replies/Threads', sum(dropped_replies), concat('-', toString(round(100.0 * sum(dropped_replies) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1)), '%') FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT '3. Dropped: Non-English', sum(dropped_non_en), concat('-', toString(round(100.0 * sum(dropped_non_en) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1)), '%') FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT '4. Passed Sieve to NATS', sum(passed_sieve), concat(toString(round(100.0 * sum(passed_sieve) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1)), '%') FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT '5. Enriched in ClickHouse', count(*), 'Enriched' FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT '6. Escalated Breaking Claims', countIf(is_breaking_claim >= 0.95), concat(toString(round(100.0 * countIf(is_breaking_claim >= 0.95) / nullIf(count(*), 0), 2)), '%') FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT toStartOfInterval(created_at, INTERVAL 10 SECOND) AS time, category, count(*) AS count FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time, category ORDER BY time

SELECT toString(created_at) AS timestamp, category, geo_region, round(is_breaking_claim, 2) AS breaking_conf, round(virality, 2) AS virality, text FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE is_breaking_claim >= 0.85 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 25
